statements.attributed: studied the microstructure and mechanical properties of the equiatomic composition alloys FeCrCoNi, FeCrCoNiV, FeCrCoNiMn, and FeCrCoNiMnV under as-solidified and annealed conditions
statements.quote: Salishchev et al. studied the microstructure and mechanical properties of the equiatomic composition alloys FeCrCoNi, FeCrCoNiV, FeCrCoNiMn, and FeCrCoNiMnV under as-solidified and annealed conditions.

statements.attributed: found that the strength increases gradually with the increase of strain to 1 GPa with an elongation to failure of about 35% after four passes
statements.quote: Using equal-channel angular pressing, Shahmir et al. investigated the mechanical properties of CoCrFeNiMn high-entropy alloy and found that the strength increases gradually with the increase of strain to 1 GPa with an elongation to failure of about 35% after four passes.

statements.attributed: showed that the addition of carbon increases dislocation activity while simultaneously retarding deformation twinning during rolling and decreases the fraction of twin boundaries in the annealed condition
statements.quote: Stepanov et al. studied the effect of thermomechanical processing on the microstructure of the carbon-containing CoCrFeNiMn high-entropy alloy, and their results showed that the addition of carbon increases dislocation activity while simultaneously retarding deformation twinning during rolling and decreases the fraction of twin boundaries in the annealed condition.

statements.attributed: found that the grain size was gradually refined from ~60 μm to ~30 nm while the dislocation density and the twin-fault probability increased to very high values
statements.quote: Heczel et al. used the high-pressure torsion (HPT) method to investigate the defect structure and hardness in nanocrystalline CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy, and found that the grain size was gradually refined from ~60 μm to ~30 nm while the dislocation density and the twin-fault probability increased to very high values.

statements.attributed: found that the bulk modulus is 117.5 GPa and 136.1 GPa for the HPSed CoCrFeCuNi and CoCrFeMnNi HEAs, respectively
statements.quote: Yu et al. prepared CoCrFeCuNi and CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloys via mechanical alloying and high-pressure sintering (HPS) and found that the bulk modulus is 117.5 GPa and 136.1 GPa for the HPSed CoCrFeCuNi and CoCrFeMnNi HEAs, respectively.

statements.attributed: adapted high-vacuum radio frequency magnetron sputtering to obtain an equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy thin film and investigated its mechanical properties
statements.quote: Dang et al. adapted high-vacuum radio frequency magnetron sputtering to obtain an equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy thin film and investigated its mechanical properties.

statements.attributed: proposed that the paramagnetic state increases the mechanical stability of the FCC phase against tetragonal deformation as compared to the ferromagnetic state
statements.quote: Theoretically, Tian et al. studied the magnetic states of CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy, and they proposed that the paramagnetic state increases the mechanical stability of the FCC phase against tetragonal deformation as compared to the ferromagnetic state.

statements.attributed: found that these two stoichiometric compositions have Young's moduli of 81 GPa and 103 GPa, respectively, and the plasticity in the single crystal CoCrFeMnNi nucleates through the formation of intrinsic stacking faults during high-rate compression or tension
statements.quote: Based on molecular dynamics computer simulations, Korchuganov researched the mechanical response of bulk Co10Cr10Fe30Mn30Ni20 and Co30Cr30Fe10Mn10Ni20 and found that these two stoichiometric compositions have Young’s moduli of 81 GPa and 103 GPa, respectively, and the plasticity in the single crystal CoCrFeMnNi nucleates through the formation of intrinsic stacking faults during high-rate compression or tension.

statements.attributed: developed Fast Parallel Algorithms for Short-Range Molecular Dynamics
statements.quote: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were performed using the LAMMPS software (Sandia National Laboratories, Philadelphia, PA, USA) , based on Newtonian motion equations.

statements.attributed: developed a modified embedded-atom method potential
statements.quote: The interatomic interactions were described by the modified embedded-atom method potential .

statements.attributed: developed a tool for manipulating and converting atomic data files
statements.quote: The four seed models of CoCrFeNiMn high-entropy alloy with an average grain size of 3.6–2.0 nm were built based on Voronoi construction through the Atomsk .

statements.attributed: developed the Open Visualization Tool for visualization and analysis of atomistic simulation data
statements.quote: The OVITO software was selected for visualization of the atomic snapshots of the seed samples.

statements.attributed: measured the lattice parameter of CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy to be 0.3590 nm
statements.quote: Using the present interatomic potential, the calculated lattice parameter of CoCrFeNiMn high-entropy alloy with a perfect FCC structure is about 0.3608 nm at 300 K and 0 GPa, which is agreement with the experimental values (0.3590 nm and 0.3592 nm ).
